description: Signals are read outside the reactive context that should track them.
detection_hint: Inspect signal reads cached in plain fields or performed before computed/effect/template evaluation.
fix_guidance: Read the signal inside the tracked computation or pass the current value explicitly.

description: An effect writes signals without a justified synchronization boundary.
detection_hint: Find effect bodies that call signal set/update or indirectly mutate reactive state.
fix_guidance: Prefer computed state or explicit event-driven updates; document unavoidable synchronization.

description: Observable or output subscriptions outlive their owner.
detection_hint: Find subscribe calls without takeUntilDestroyed, AsyncPipe, toSignal, or explicit scoped cleanup.
fix_guidance: Bind subscriptions to DestroyRef or use framework-managed reactive interop.

description: OnPush inputs or signal-backed collections are mutated in place.
detection_hint: Look for push/splice/property assignment on input values or signal values.
fix_guidance: Create a new immutable value and update through the owning boundary.

description: Template control flow lacks stable tracking or repeats expensive expressions.
detection_hint: Inspect loops without stable track keys and method calls or pipes repeated in templates.
fix_guidance: Track by stable identity and precompute expensive derived values.

description: Dependency injection uses an inconsistent or inheritance-fragile pattern.
detection_hint: Find constructor injection mixed with inject(), especially in base classes or field initialization ordering.
fix_guidance: Follow the project convention and keep injection timing explicit.
